purpose: Teach: サンプリング/割愛/懸案/編入/確固たる/バックグラウンド/アウトプット/転嫁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、データのサンプリング方法を学べ
lines.en: Ren, you need to learn proper data-sampling methodology.
lines.style: Measured, direct instruction. Opens with the name — establishing focus. Steady eye contact. No harshness, but the kind of clarity that expects compliance. A mentor's expectation built on trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文では枝葉の議論を割愛します
lines.en: Yes. I'll leave the peripheral details out of the paper.
lines.style: Quiet, attentive response. Slight nod in the voice. Deliberate pacing — he's thinking through what he just heard. No defensiveness, only careful consideration and respect for the guidance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究室の懸案事項に取り組め
lines.en: Ren, tackle the lab's outstanding issues.
lines.style: Firm directive. No softening, but not unkind. The tone of someone who sees capability and expects it to be used. Brief, because he means it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。海外大学院への編入も検討しております
lines.en: Yes. I'm already considering transfer to a graduate program overseas.
lines.style: Careful, slightly defensive undertone. He's answering before he was fully asked — trying to show he's already thinking ahead. Respectful but with a small tremor of self-protection underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、確固たる仮説を立てて挑め
lines.en: Ren, build a firm hypothesis and attack it.
lines.style: Clipped, purposeful. Light emphasis on 'firm' — not hesitant thinking. A challenge delivered without doubt that he can meet it. The kind of push that comes from believing someone is ready.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。被験者のバックグラウンドを記録します
lines.en: Yes. I'll document each subject's background thoroughly.
lines.style: Formal, careful response. Slightly slower pace — he's noting the instruction and already planning how to execute. No wasted words. The politeness of someone taking something seriously.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究のアウトプットを積極的に発信しろ
lines.en: Ren, actively share your research output with others.
lines.style: More expansive than the previous directives. Slight warmth underneath the instruction — this is about Ren stepping into the world, not just working harder. Still authoritative, but encouraging.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。責任を他者に転嫁する事はいたしません
lines.en: Yes. I won't shift responsibility onto anyone else.
lines.style: Formal close. A promise, not just compliance. Deliberate and measured. Ends quietly — the punctuation of something serious being understood and accepted.
